filter_tradeoff_insights: TENURE is the binding constraint. Relaxing freehold->include 99-yr immediately opens three large in-band 3BR stacks (Kovan Residences, Sims Urban Oasis, Bartley Residences). A ~$250-400 psf leasehold discount buys the size the buyer wants — the sharpest trade-off this run.

UNITS vs PSF: the only clean freehold passes are value outliers in LARGE developments (Vacanza 473u, Palm Grove 111u) or a tiny boutique at the cap (Carpmael 16u). Big-development freehold gives the price break; boutique freehold makes you pay to the ceiling.

REGION: D15 = deepest in-band FH choice + near-term TEL5 (H2 2026). D19 = thinnest FH band but Palm Grove is the sweet spot + CRL 2030 upside. D14 Eunos/Paya Lebar = fewest in-band FH options (Paya Lebar Residences just over cap).

PRICE CAP: a ~$150k lift (to ~$2.35M) is the single highest-leverage relaxation — it converts two strong near-misses (Elliot, Paya Lebar Residences) into passes without touching the tenure or district filters.
